meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Browse the web for any task — research topics, read articles, interact with web apps, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data, and test web pages. Use whenever a browser would be useful, not just when the user explicitly asks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用浏览器自动完成网页浏览、数据提取和测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器完成各种网页任务
copy.tagline_en: Automate web browsing, data extraction, and testing with a browser
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to programmatically control a browser for web tasks

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能操控浏览器:开网页、点按钮、填表单、截图、取文字、存 PDF。要上网时自动用。
howto.when: 当任务需要查资料、读文章、操作网页等,且浏览器有帮助时,即使你没说,它也会自动使用。

say.text: 打开 https://example.com,提取商品名称和价格
say.note: Claude 会打开网页并提取信息

say.text: 帮我搜索‘AI 最新进展’,列出前三篇文章标题和链接
say.note: Claude 会搜索并整理结果

say.text: 自动填写登录表单并提交,然后截屏保存
say.note: Claude 会操作表单并保存截图

howto.what_en: Claude can control a browser: open pages, click buttons, fill forms, screenshot, extract text, and save PDF. It does this automatically when web access is needed.
howto.when_en: When the task involves researching, reading articles, or interacting with web pages and a browser would help, even if not explicitly asked.

say_en.text: Open https://example.com and extract product names and prices.
Search for 'latest AI progress' and list top three articles.
Fill out the login form, submit it, and take a screenshot.
say_en.note: Claude will operate the form and save the shot.
